# studio-actions

Follow [host conventions](../../HARNESS.md) for Claude Code or Codex.

Every capability in the Maude studio has exactly one AI path (contract V2-1.11 §5.1). Find it below, then:

- **file**: edit that file. Use `Edit` on existing canvases, never a whole-file `Write`. Hooks run `maude design check --strict` on every write and restore the file on an error. Read the named skill first, because it teaches the format.
- **verb**: run the `maude` verb. `auto` verbs run without a prompt in the Maude chat. `prompt` verbs show the person a permission card.
- **person**: only the person does this. Tell them where it is. Never script it, and no verb is designed for it.
- **not yet**: the AI path lands with the package named. Until then, say it can't be done from here yet.

Validate a file yourself with `maude design check <file> --strict [--against <before>]`.

## Formats you edit (8)

| Format | Files | Schema | Strict check | Skill |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `canvas-tsx` | <designRoot>/**/*.tsx (canvases, outside system/) | `apps/studio/schema/canvas-tsx.md` | parse; DCArtboard ids present + unique; V2-1.4 element ids vs the snapshot (checkIds) | `design:design#_guide-02` |
| `annotations` | <designRoot>/**/*.annotations.json | `apps/studio/schema/annotations.v2.schema.json` | validateBoard(text, {strict:true}) — the AiBatch rule applied to the file | `design:whiteboard` |
| `canvas-meta` | <designRoot>/**/*.meta.json | `apps/studio/schema/canvas-meta.v2.schema.json` | the v2 schema on the keys the write changed; no viewport; dsRev unchanged | `design:design#_guide-17` |
| `edl` | <designRoot>/**/*.edl.json | `apps/studio/schema/edl.v1.schema.json` | validateEdl (footage/schema.ts); the schema mirrors it | `design:footage-director` |
| `tokens` | <designRoot>/system/<ds>/tokens.json | `apps/studio/schema/ds-tokens-v1.schema.json` | ds-check <ds> structure, as warnings (V2-1.13) | `design:design-system` |
| `components` | <designRoot>/system/<ds>/components.json | `apps/studio/schema/ds-components-v1.schema.json` | ds-check <ds> structure, as warnings (V2-1.13) | `design:design-system` |
| `design-config` | .design/config.json | `apps/studio/config.schema.json` | parses (the schema is the doc; the studio lints it at boot) | `design:design` |
| `agent-handoff` | <designRoot>/_runs/<runId>/handoff/<agent>-<n>.{in,out}.json | `cli/lib/handoff.schema.json` | validateHandoff (cli/lib/handoff.mjs) for the role the file name declares | `design:design#_guide-08` |
